limitations: Container CPU caps exceed available shared-host capacity; limits are ceilings rather than dedicated resources.
Diagnostics and JFR add observer overhead; CPU/query samples include observer work.
Timer means use count/sum deltas. Phases overlap; do not sum timer means or percentiles. Hikari aggregates include multiple and background acquisitions.
Final profiling lag precedes settling; final reconciliation separately establishes convergence.
Raw JFR, SQL, logs, host/environment inspection, fixture secrets and local paths are intentionally excluded.
No 24-hour soak, hosted CI, production capacity, HA or continuous-operation claim is established.
